lines.text: [long pause] [deadpan] I have seen cluttered ideas. This is not an idea. This is a junk drawer.

lines.text: [interrupting] [dry laugh] The hard constraint here is the entire concept. Physics would like its afternoon back.

lines.text: [softly] I want to be fair. Who are the first hundred users? [pause] Right. Nobody.

lines.text: [sharply] And whose fault is this? You two keep shouting ship it, and look what ships.

lines.text: [overlapping] My fault? You would cut every feature, including the point.

lines.text: [quietly] I am going to step out. I wish you luck. I mean that as the harshest thing I can say.

verdict.summary: The council rejected this idea so hard that one member left the call.
verdict.roast: The council did not just disagree with this pitch. One of them left the call. It was cluttered, unconstrained, and had no users, which is a rare triple. Reading the room is a skill, and this pitch read none of it.
